categories.main_business_segments: Shengyuan Environmental Protection Co., Ltd primarily operates in urban solid and liquid waste specialized treatment, focusing on municipal solid waste incineration power generation and domestic sewage treatment. The company also engages in upstream and downstream activities including waste transportation, kitchen waste processing, leachate treatment, and steam and heat supply. Additionally, it is expanding into the taurine health industry and hydrogen energy sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes mature and internationally recognized mechanical grate furnace technology for waste incineration, with ongoing upgrades to mid-temperature and sub-high-pressure boiler technology to improve thermal efficiency. It integrates AI and big data for intelligent combustion control to enhance operational efficiency and environmental performance. In the health sector, advanced ethylene oxide methods are used for taurine production, and in hydrogen energy, it focuses on solid-state hydrogen storage and waste-to-hydrogen technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government entities and state-owned enterprises responsible for municipal waste management and power grid companies purchasing electricity. The company serves municipal governments for waste treatment and power generation, with electricity sold primarily to the State Grid. The health products target broad consumer markets, while hydrogen energy research serves emerging industrial applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in several Chinese provinces including Fujian, Shandong, Jiangsu, Anhui, and Gansu. The company’s waste treatment plants and projects are distributed across these regions, with new business developments also located in industrial parks such as the Quangang Petrochemical Park in Fujian.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shengyuan operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the waste management supply chain, managing waste incineration plants and sewage treatment facilities under BOT and PPP models. It controls the investment, construction, operation, and maintenance of these facilities, and also engages in waste collection and transportation upstream.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is dual-pronged: consolidating and enhancing its core waste incineration power generation business through technological upgrades and operational efficiency improvements, while aggressively developing new growth areas in taurine-based health products and hydrogen energy. R&D efforts emphasize AI-driven smart combustion, solid-state hydrogen storage, and innovative taurine derivative products, supported by multiple national and provincial research projects.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly from waste incineration power generation through electricity sales to the grid and waste treatment fees under long-term concession agreements. Sewage treatment fees are charged based on treated volumes. The company also earns income from PPP project construction services and sales of health products. Electricity tariffs include government subsidies and green certificate trading revenues.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include China Everbright Environment Group, Zhejiang Weiming Environmental Protection, Green Power Environmental Group, Wangneng Environment, China Tianying, Hanlan Environment, and Chongqing Sanfeng Environment Group. Shengyuan is positioned as a leading mid-sized player with strong technical capabilities, stable project portfolio, and above-industry-average profitability metrics.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Shengyuan reported total revenue of approximately RMB 1.58 billion, a slight decline from the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders increasing by 24.29% to RMB 182 million. Total assets reached RMB 8.7 billion, with steady growth in operating cash flow and equity. The company maintains a stable asset-liability ratio around 57.77%, reflecting its capital-intensive business model and ongoing investments in new projects.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shengyuan emphasizes its nearly two decades of specialized experience in waste incineration power generation, leveraging advanced mechanical grate furnace technology and AI-enabled smart combustion systems to achieve high operational efficiency and environmental compliance. Its integrated 'incineration plus' business model expands waste treatment capacity and resource utilization, while its pioneering development in taurine health products and hydrogen energy positions it for future growth and diversification.
